reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Gordon and his team of lads resurfaced our shared drive in tarmac. The quote was very reasonable, they turned up on time and their work was efficient and quick. … They were very respectful, didn’t hear any bad language, they tidied up as they worked and completed the work in a day. Would definitely recommend!
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Gordon and team repaired and resurfaced a part of the road, for our private lane. They were excellent, gave a good quote, came at the day and time stated and did exactly what was agreed, They were friendly and helpful and it was clear they worked as a team. …
items.label: Which? review

items.text: My son and I are very pleased with my new resin driveway and footpaths. Gordon Hill and Sons acted professionally and efficiently and worked well as a team; they were punctual and friendly. … They charged a fair price, and liaised well with the team who laid the resin on the final day. We are delighted with the finished driveway …
